text: So here is the whole lesson on the model you have been looking at. An enzyme is a globular protein and a biological catalyst; some work inside the cell, intracellular, and some are secreted to work outside, extracellular. On the enzyme, the active site, complementary to its substrate: that is specificity. The substrate binds, held by temporary bonds: the enzyme–substrate complex. Inside it the reaction happens with a lower activation energy, so it is faster. The products leave and the enzyme is unchanged. Two hypotheses: lock-and-key, a fixed shape; induced fit, the active site changes shape to fit and returns afterwards.
